movie.title: The Gorals
movie.overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: With college entrance exams fast approaching, two neglected high schoolers ditch school to search for a lost duck in an abandoned meadow, unexpectedly embarking on a journey of wild survival and self-discovery.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In-hye, a student more interested in tending to the school's animal pen than preparing for upcoming college entrance exams, spends her days lecturing a duck named Hee-seon. Joined by Seo-hee, who was assigned to the pen as punishment for carrying a knife, the two girls stumble upon an abandoned meadow where they accidentally lose the bird. Rather than attending their crucial college interviews alongside a group of fellow neglected students, In-hye and Seo-hee decide to skip school and camp in the meadow. As they search for Hee-seon, the two teenagers gradually adapt to the wild, forging an unexpected bond while learning to survive on their own terms.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: With only 200 days remaining before the high-stakes college entrance exams, high school student In-hye spends her time caring for the school's animal pen rather than focusing on her studies. Her daily routine involves lecturing a duck named Hee-seon instead of preparing for her academic future. Meanwhile, fellow student Seo-hee is assigned to help with the animal pen as a disciplinary measure after being caught carrying a knife. While exploring near the school, the two girls discover a secluded, abandoned meadow, but their quiet retreat takes a chaotic turn when Hee-seon escapes and disappears into the overgrown landscape. Simultaneously, a dedicated teacher named Kim Ah-tae forms a specialized college interview preparation group for four of the school's most neglected students. On the long-awaited day of the interviews, In-hye and Seo-hee make the drastic decision to abandon their academic obligations entirely to launch a search party for their lost duck. Returning to the meadow, they pitch a camp and begin living off the land, determined not to leave until they find Hee-seon. Cut off from the pressures of school and society, the pair slowly learn the fundamentals of wilderness survival. Through their shared struggle against nature and isolation, they confront their personal anxieties, forge a deep bond, and ultimately carve out a sense of independence away from the rigid expectations of their school life.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the intense pressure of impending college entrance exams, 'The Gorals' follows In-hye, a teenager who finds solace in the school animal pen rather than her textbooks, and Seo-hee, a troubled student assigned to punishment duty. When a lost duck leads them away from their academic responsibilities and into an abandoned meadow, the two outcast girls trade the classroom for the wilderness. This poignant drama explores youth, rebellion, and survival as two neglected teenagers step away from societal expectations to forge their own path.

story_structure.resolution: Through their shared wilderness experience, In-hye and Seo-hee forge a deep resilience and understanding of independence, ultimately reshaping how they view their path forward outside conventional expectations.

story_structure.risingAction: Rather than attending their critical college interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee decide to ditch school to search for Hee-seon, setting up camp in the meadow and learning to navigate and survive in the wild together.
